name: nanochat
description: The best ChatGPT that $100 can buy.
one_liner: A complete, minimal recipe for training your own small ChatGPT-style AI from scratch for under $100 of cloud GPU time.
buyer: Mostly students, researchers, and educators — not really a paying business buyer; this is a teaching and research tool, not a commercial product.
business_use_cases: A university course uses it as the hands-on lab for teaching how large language models are actually trained end-to-end.
An AI bootcamp sells a cohort-based course built around reproducing and tweaking the speedrun.
A GPU cloud provider uses it as a reference workload to market their hardware to AI researchers.

money_ideas.idea: A paid cohort course teaching people to run and extend the speedrun on rented GPUs.

steal_this: Package a guided, paid weekend workshop — 'train your own tiny ChatGPT' — for curious non-ML engineers, using this repo as the technical backbone.
